Website information

This website explains SiteSutra services and working methods. It is general information, not a binding quotation, guarantee or automatic agreement to provide services.

Proposals and project terms

A project begins only after the parties agree the written scope, fee, payment milestones, responsibilities, ownership, confidentiality terms and delivery dependencies. A page on this website does not replace that signed agreement.

Prices and availability

Published starting prices describe the assumptions stated on the relevant service page. Added scope, taxes, licences and provider costs are confirmed in the actual proposal. Availability and delivery dates are not reserved until the proposal and scheduling payment are accepted.

Examples and outcomes

Work labelled as a concept or demonstration is not a client engagement. SiteSutra does not guarantee rankings, traffic, revenue, enquiries or third party platform decisions.

Intellectual property

SiteSutra website copy, original graphics and demonstrations may not be republished as another provider’s work. Client ownership and source delivery are governed by the applicable project agreement and third party licences.
